Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: SoundWave Solutions, Inc. specializes in the sales, rental, installation, maintenance, and repair of audio and visual equipment. Our operations include retail sales of high-quality sound systems, projectors, home theater setups, and professional-grade A/V gear. We also provide rental services for events, along with expert installation and setup for residential and commercial clients. Our skilled technicians ensure that all installations meet safety standards, while we offer comprehensive maintenance and repair services to keep equipment in optimal working condition. Additionally, we focus on providing excellent customer service, addressing clients' unique needs, and offering guidance on the best A/V solutions for their environments.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On April 15, 2022, a client reported damage to rented audio equipment due to an unexpected power surge, resulting in a loss of $5,000. The claim is currently in process with the insurance company for resolution. On July 10, 2023, a delivery vehicle was involved in an accident, causing damage to a projector valued at $2,500. This incident is under review, and we are awaiting an assessment from our insurer. Additionally, in December 2021, we experienced a theft of rental equipment valued at $7,500, which was reported to the police and has been settled through our property insurance. All losses have been communicated to our insurer and are being properly documented.
